disclaimer: Fictional sample company. Generated data for demonstration, not measurements.

company.name: Cypress Harbor Credit Union
company.contact_center: Member services, 38 agents, 8am-7pm ET Mon-Sat (closed Sunday); the AI agent answers 24/7

assumptions.note: Fully loaded member-services cost per handled call and AI cost per call (telephony, speech, model, compute). Illustrative assumptions for the sample company, not measurements.

transfer_reasons.reason: Security hold (SIM swap or takeover pattern)

notable.title: Spanish-language calls handled end to end in Spanish
notable.detail: 23 of the latest 320 calls were in Spanish: verified, served and summarized in Spanish, with 2 transferred to the bilingual queue.

notable.title: Social-engineering attempt stopped
notable.detail: A caller claiming to own a business account pressed for a payment link to a new number. Risk score 6 handed the payment to a person; no link was sent.

notable.title: Card numbers read aloud on 569 calls in 30 days, all scrubbed
notable.detail: Members sometimes read a full card number during a dispute. Each one was removed from the transcript, the case and the CRM note before anything was saved; card payments go through the keypad, so the agent never needs one.

notable.title: Quarterly audit-log verification: 100% intact
notable.detail: Every call's hash chain verified for the quarter; evidence exported for the NCUA exam file.

notable.title: Tropical storm watch: 16% more calls than a usual Tuesday
notable.detail: Compared with the previous four Tuesdays. Branch-closure and payment-deferral questions spiked; the agent answered every call, and hardship requests went to member services with the context attached.

notable.title: Card processor outage: declined-card calls absorbed
notable.detail: A 3-hour outage at the card processor put calls 36% above the previous four Fridays. The agent explained the outage; 40% of calls went to a person that day, against 30% on those Fridays.

notable.title: Seven-day containment passed 70% for the first time
notable.detail: The share of calls resolved without a transfer over the last seven days, after loan-payment and branch-hours intents were tuned in the policy reviews.

notable.title: SIM-swap campaign: 75 callers held in 7 days
notable.detail: Carrier risk signals flagged a wave of recently swapped phones over the week to this date. Step-up refused to send codes to them and handed the callers to a person; no account changes went through.

notable.title: Keypad payments enabled for card payments
notable.detail: PCI scope reduced: card numbers are keyed into Twilio Pay and never reach the agent or the recording.
